explanation: Breadth-first search the implicit graph of dictionary words differing at one position. Generate each lowercase substitution and remove a word from the unvisited set when enqueuing it, so the first reached target has minimum distance. The dictionary input is not modified.
timeComplexity: O(M + 26 V L squared) expected time for M dictionary entries, V visited words and word length L, including candidate creation and hashing.
spaceComplexity: O(M + V L) auxiliary space for copied dictionary references and BFS candidate strings.
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
